native.caveat: This list documents native OnHit definitions. It does NOT mean every listed passive or accessory skill has a restored activation/trigger path.

changes: Native repel distance/duration now create authoritative displacement on actual mob/boss contact
Projectile impact carries travel angle and companion actor/source into OnHit; melee pushes away from actual attacker
Shared room displacement advances before the250ms AI gate on50ms world timer; no per-observer duplicate integration
Swept city/building collision, sampled water and protected-area body footprint checks stop travel at boundaries
Known native control/debuff/repel immunity buffs block corresponding new OnHit statuses
Cancels pending monster cast and pauses its normal AI during displacement; death/scene/source/identity changes cancel remaining travel
Bounded per-observer pending position correction retries failed final move/buff removal using latest authoritative position
DOT wake recomputes surviving status flags in same AI pass, eliminating extra controlled step after sleep removal

policies.trajectory: Linear distance over native200ms. Projectile direction follows travel; melee uses actual attacker-to-target vector, exact overlap uses cursor. These direction/motion rules are reconstructed, not original server source.
policies.replacement: New repel replaces remaining travel from current position; it does not accumulate pending distance. Different repel type removes previous status. Cancelled travel does not restart.
policies.collision: MonsterContent.CollideSize max dimension/2, fallback40, clamp1..600; circle approximation even for rectangular monsters. Expanded city/building ray colliders,20-unit boundary sampling and12-step bisection; first blocker stops entire movement. Map bounds, full target-body safe area footprint and native water.canMove policy used. Shape/curve/stop policy not proven retail.
policies.ai: Pending monster casts interrupted; normal AI paused during active displacement. Reconstructed gameplay policy, not inferred solely from isBanSkill (native249 has isBanSkill=false).
policies.immunity: Explicit known control IDs125,256,274,393,441,658,695,720,829; debuff IDs256,274,720;442 blocks repel only,451 blocks450 only. Uses native isCtrl/isDebuff classification and valid/unexpired wire buffs. Complete immunity semantics, activation, cleansing and stacking remain incomplete.
policies.bosses: No new implicit immunity for every boss. Active native immunity buffs are respected. monsterRepel261 excludes bosses by native small/elite description. Full boss immunity activation is NOT restored or claimed.
policies.lifecycle: Source death/scene-not-ready/world replacement/map or room change/source safe-zone entry, pet death/mount/removal, target death/respawn, control removal and newly gained immunity cancel. No-peer rooms discard travel/status. These cancellation choices are local.
policies.correction: One pending record per seen target per observer; latest position/buff snapshot retried each environment/world frame. Drops on lost visibility/death/record or spawn identity change. This handles final displacement updates only, not general UI/texture queue or every skill event.

tests.nativeVM: Executed original BuffCfg factory and BuffSchemeTable.load/getBuffBytype; validates249/261/442 and native200ms Strong control. Not Windows rendering.
